verdict.rationale: RingCentral's developer guide has a first-party section on event notifications and subscriptions, so the product documents a native event-subscription mechanism. The pack does not show that delivery happens via registrable outbound HTTP webhook callbacks, as opposed to another transport. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of webhook (HTTP POST) delivery, details on registering and validating webhook endpoints, event type coverage, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
